mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id AS id, c.product_id AS productId, p.model AS productName, pi.storage_path AS productImage, p.price, c.quantity, p.stock, (c.select_status = 1) AS selected, pd.parameters AS specifications, b.brand_name AS brandName FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand = b.brand_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MIN(image_id) AS image_id FROM product_image WHERE image_type = 'main' GROUP BY product_id ) pri ON p.product_id = pri.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_image pi ON pri.image_id = pi.id LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON p.product_id = pd.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.cart_id ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
